rows.label: The Duviri Paradox
rows.note: unlocks Teshin's Cave and the armory rack

conditions: You cannot re-enter Teshin's Cave once you step through the portal — buy the blueprint before you leave.

groups.activity: clear Isleweaver, or the Duviri Experience / Lone Story Orowyrm

rows.label: Isleweaver completion
rows.note: 15 on Steel Path; needs The Hex quest; drops almost none of Edun's own build materials

rows.label: optional Undercroft side portal
rows.note: 3 each on Steel Path; story-stage portals give nothing

conditions: Pathos Clamps ignore Resource Boosters, Drop Chance Boosters, blessings and Bountiful Harvest.
Isleweaver drops almost none of Edun's own build materials (no Nacreous Pebble at all), so a Duviri Experience trip is still owed regardless of clamp route.
bonuses: 8-12 minutes for 15 clamps on Steel Path Isleweaver, and it's your own Warframe and Amp, so a bad Teshin's Cave loadout roll doesn't matter.
Clearing all three optional Undercroft portals on Steel Path gives 24 clamps in about 18-20 minutes.

disclosures.title: which run to pick
disclosures.body: Normal-mode Duviri Experience (10-15 minutes for 10 clamps) beats Steel Path (~30 minutes for 15) unless you also want the arcanes and Steel Essence from the SP Undercroft.

groups.activity: buy the blueprint at the armory rack
conditions: Delivers the Warframe-compatible blueprint to the Foundry in the same purchase that unlocks the Drifter version.
If sold, Cephalon Simaris resells the Warframe blueprint for 100,000 standing.

groups.activity: Maw Feeding, cave and plant gathering

rows.label: Tasoma Extract
rows.note: Duviri caves, 2-4 per node; farm solo so a host hasn't already stripped the deposits

rows.label: Rune Marrow
rows.note: Runic Compact deposits in the Undercroft or the Circuit; guaranteed from Corrupted Vor and Corrupted Jackal

rows.label: Connla Sprout
rows.note: grows near water and caves, densest around the Lunaro Court

conditions: Resources bank the moment a decree is earned — gather materials, complete one side objective, then abort the mission to skip the Orowyrm entirely and keep everything.
bonuses: SPROUT in Teshin's Cave grows 6 random Duviri plants free every 20 hours.
Bountiful Harvest decree doubles plant pickups before you touch any plant node.
Riding Intrinsics rank 5 (Smooth Path) highlights nearby resources while mounted; fly under the landmass on the Kaithe to spot cave mouths.

disclosures.title: known issues
disclosures.body: The throw animation steps the frame forward before releasing, so it lands off your aim, worse with attack speed or Tennokai. Heavy-attack-exclusive effects (Killing Blow, Life Strike, True Steel) only apply if you're still in the heavy-attack animation when the spear connects — the explosion essentially never benefits, and Condition Overload gives only 20% per status on the initial hit and nothing on the explosion.
